question: How many World Cup tournaments does the graph cover?
paraphrases: How many World Cups are in the graph, men's and women's together?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament) RETURN count(t) AS tournaments

question: How many of the tournaments are Women's World Cups?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament) WHERE t.name CONTAINS "Women's" RETURN count(t) AS womens_world_cups

question: How many national teams are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team) RETURN count(t) AS teams

question: How many World Cup matches does the graph hold?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: How many own goals have been scored at the World Cup?
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal) WHERE g.own_goal = true RETURN count(g) AS own_goals

question: How many stadiums have hosted World Cup matches?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stadium) RETURN count(s) AS stadiums

question: How many managers are in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (m:Manager) RETURN count(m) AS managers

question: How many players are there in each playing position?
paraphrases: Break the players down by position.
cypher: MATCH (p:Player) RETURN p.position AS position, count(p) AS players

question: Which World Cup stadium has the largest capacity, and how big is it?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stadium) RETURN s.name AS stadium, s.city AS city, s.capacity AS capacity ORDER BY capacity DESC, stadium LIMIT 1

question: Who won the {year} World Cup?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament {year: $year}) RETURN t.winner AS winner

question: Which country hosted the {year} World Cup?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament {year: $year}) RETURN t.host_country AS host

question: How many teams took part in the {year} World Cup?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament {year: $year}) RETURN t.count_teams AS teams

question: How many of the teams belong to the {confederation}?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team {confederation: $confederation}) RETURN count(t) AS teams

params.name: confederation
enum_values: Confederation of North, Central American and Caribbean Association Football

question: What is the three-letter country code of {team}?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team {name: $team}) RETURN t.code AS code

question: Which World Cup match drew the biggest crowd?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) WHERE m.attendance IS NOT NULL RETURN m.name AS match, m.date AS date, m.attendance AS crowd ORDER BY crowd DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many World Cups has each nation won, counting men's and women's titles together, most titles first (ties alphabetically)?
paraphrases: Which countries have won the World Cup, and how many times?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament) RETURN t.winner AS team, count(t) AS titles ORDER BY titles DESC, team

question: Which teams have won the Women's World Cup, and how many times each (most first, ties alphabetically)?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament) WHERE t.name CONTAINS "Women's" RETURN t.winner AS team, count(t) AS titles ORDER BY titles DESC, team

question: Which players have scored at least 12 World Cup goals, not counting own goals? List them by goals, then by name.
paraphrases: Who are the all-time World Cup top scorers with 12 or more goals?
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player) WHERE g.own_goal = false WITH p, count(g) AS goals WHERE goals >= 12 RETURN CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END AS player, goals ORDER BY goals DESC, player

question: How many World Cup goals did {player} score?
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player) WHERE g.own_goal = false AND CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END = $player RETURN count(g) AS goals

question: Which players have scored four or more penalties at the World Cup? List them by penalties, then by name.
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player) WHERE g.penalty = true WITH p, count(g) AS penalties WHERE penalties >= 4 RETURN CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END AS player, penalties ORDER BY penalties DESC, player

question: Which World Cup match had the most goals in total?
paraphrases: What is the highest-scoring World Cup game ever?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) RETURN m.name AS match, m.date AS date, m.home_score AS home_goals, m.away_score AS away_goals, m.home_score + m.away_score AS total_goals ORDER BY total_goals DESC, date LIMIT 1

question: Which matches were won by a margin of nine goals or more? Biggest margin first, then by date.
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) WITH m, abs(m.home_score - m.away_score) AS margin WHERE margin >= 9 RETURN m.name AS match, m.date AS date, m.home_score AS home_goals, m.away_score AS away_goals, margin ORDER BY margin DESC, date

question: How many World Cup matches has {team} played, men's and women's combined?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(t:Team {name: $team}) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: How many World Cup matches has {team} won, counting penalty-shootout wins as wins?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[r:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(t:Team {name: $team}) WHERE ((type(r) = 'HOME_TEAM' AND m.result = 'home team win') OR (type(r) = 'AWAY_TEAM' AND m.result = 'away team win')) RETURN count(m) AS wins

question: In how many different World Cups has {team} played a match?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team {name: $team})<-[:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]-(m:Match)-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(tr:Tournament) RETURN count(DISTINCT tr) AS tournaments

question: How many World Cup stadiums are in {country}?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stadium {country: $country}) RETURN count(s) AS stadiums

question: How many World Cup matches have been played at {stadium}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:PLAYED_AT]->(s:Stadium {name: $stadium}) RETURN count(m) AS matches

question: Which stadium names appear on more than one stadium record, and how many records each? List alphabetically by stadium.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stadium) WITH s.name AS stadium, count(s) AS records WHERE records > 1 RETURN stadium, records ORDER BY stadium

question: Which stadiums have hosted at least 14 World Cup matches? Most matches first, then by name.
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:PLAYED_AT]->(s:Stadium) WITH s, count(m) AS matches WHERE matches >= 14 RETURN s.name AS stadium, s.city AS city, matches ORDER BY matches DESC, stadium

question: Which players have appeared at six or more World Cups?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.count_tournaments >= 6 RETURN CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END AS player, p.count_tournaments AS tournaments

question: How many managers in the graph come from {country}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Manager {country: $country}) RETURN count(m) AS managers

question: How many goals were scored in extra time?
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal) WHERE g.period STARTS WITH 'extra time' RETURN count(g) AS goals

question: How many semi-final matches have been played in total?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) WHERE m.stage IN ['semi-final', 'semi-finals'] RETURN count(m) AS semi_finals

question: In which World Cups did the host country also win the tournament? List them by year.
paraphrases: When did a host nation win its own World Cup?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament) WHERE t.winner = t.host_country RETURN t.year AS year, t.winner AS team ORDER BY year

question: Which players scored a goal in the first minute of a World Cup match, excluding own goals?
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal {minute: 1})-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player) WHERE g.own_goal = false RETURN DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END AS player

question: What is the average number of goals per World Cup match, to two decimal places?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) RETURN round(100.0 * avg(m.home_score + m.away_score)) / 100.0 AS avg_goals

question: Who is the earliest-born player in the graph, among players with a known birth date?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.birth_date <> 'not available' RETURN CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END AS player, p.birth_date AS born ORDER BY born LIMIT 1

question: How many teams come from each region of the world? Most teams first, ties alphabetically.
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:FROM]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS region, count(t) AS teams ORDER BY teams DESC, region

question: What was the score of the {year} World Cup final?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match {stage: 'final'})-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(t:Tournament {year: $year}) RETURN m.name AS final, m.home_score AS home_goals, m.away_score AS away_goals

question: How many World Cup matches were level on goals but still had a winner, meaning they were decided by a penalty shootout?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match) WHERE m.home_score = m.away_score AND m.result <> 'draw' RETURN count(m) AS shootouts

question: Who managed {team} at the {year} World Cup?
cypher: MATCH (mg:Manager)-[:MANAGED]->(t:Team {name: $team}) MATCH (t)<-[:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]-(:Match)-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(:Tournament {year: $year}) RETURN DISTINCT mg.given_name AS given_name, mg.family_name AS family_name

question: Who refereed the {year} World Cup final?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match {stage: 'final'})-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(t:Tournament {year: $year}) WHERE m.referee IS NOT NULL RETURN m.referee AS referee

question: Who was the top scorer at the {year} World Cup, and how many goals did they score? Include everyone tied for the lead.
paraphrases: Who won the golden boot in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_IN]->(m:Match)-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(t:Tournament {year: $year}), (g)-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player) WHERE g.own_goal = false WITH p, count(g) AS goals WITH collect({player: CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END, goals: goals}) AS rows, max(goals) AS top UNWIND rows AS r WITH r, top WHERE r.goals = top RETURN r.player AS player, r.goals AS goals

question: How many times have {team_a} and {team_b} met at the World Cup, and how many of those matches did each side win (shootouts included) or draw?
cypher: MATCH (a:Team {name: $team_a})<-[ra:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]-(m:Match)-[rb:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(b:Team {name: $team_b}) RETURN count(m) AS played, sum(CASE WHEN (type(ra) = 'HOME_TEAM' AND m.result = 'home team win') OR (type(ra) = 'AWAY_TEAM' AND m.result = 'away team win') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a_won, sum(CASE WHEN (type(rb) = 'HOME_TEAM' AND m.result = 'home team win') OR (type(rb) = 'AWAY_TEAM' AND m.result = 'away team win') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b_won, sum(CASE WHEN m.result = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drawn

question: How many World Cup goals has {team} scored and how many has it conceded?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[r:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(t:Team {name: $team}) RETURN sum(CASE WHEN type(r) = 'HOME_TEAM' THEN m.home_score ELSE m.away_score END) AS scored, sum(CASE WHEN type(r) = 'HOME_TEAM' THEN m.away_score ELSE m.home_score END) AS conceded

question: In which World Cups did {player} score, and how many goals at each? List by year.
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player), (g)-[:SCORED_IN]->(:Match)-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(t:Tournament) WHERE g.own_goal = false AND CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END = $player RETURN t.year AS year, count(g) AS goals ORDER BY year

question: In which cities did {player} score World Cup goals, and how many in each? Most goals first, ties alphabetically.
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player), (g)-[:SCORED_IN]->(:Match)-[:PLAYED_AT]->(s:Stadium) WHERE g.own_goal = false AND CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END = $player RETURN s.city AS city, count(g) AS goals ORDER BY goals DESC, city

question: Which three World Cups had the highest average number of goals per match, to two decimal places?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(t:Tournament) WITH t, avg(m.home_score + m.away_score) AS avg_goals RETURN t.name AS tournament, round(100.0 * avg_goals) / 100.0 AS goals_per_match ORDER BY goals_per_match DESC, tournament LIMIT 3

question: At which five stadiums have the most World Cup goals been scored? Ties broken by stadium name.
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_IN]->(:Match)-[:PLAYED_AT]->(s:Stadium) RETURN s.name AS stadium, s.city AS city, count(g) AS goals ORDER BY goals DESC, stadium LIMIT 5

question: Which teams have played in a World Cup final (men's or women's), and how many finals each? Most finals first, ties alphabetically.
paraphrases: Which nations have reached the most World Cup finals?
cypher: MATCH (m:Match {stage: 'final'})-[:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(t:Team) RETURN t.name AS team, count(m) AS finals ORDER BY finals DESC, team

question: Which players have scored three or more goals in a single World Cup match more than once?
paraphrases: Who has more than one World Cup hat-trick?
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player), (g)-[:SCORED_IN]->(m:Match) WHERE g.own_goal = false WITH p, m, count(g) AS goals WHERE goals >= 3 WITH p, count(m) AS hat_tricks WHERE hat_tricks >= 2 RETURN CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END AS player, hat_tricks

question: How many World Cup matches have teams from each confederation won, shootouts included, listing a confederation with no wins as zero? Most wins first.
cypher: MATCH (t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (m:Match)-[r:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(t) WHERE ((type(r) = 'HOME_TEAM' AND m.result = 'home team win') OR (type(r) = 'AWAY_TEAM' AND m.result = 'away team win')) RETURN t.confederation AS confederation, count(m) AS wins ORDER BY wins DESC, confederation

question: Which teams have won at least two World Cup penalty shootouts (matches level on goals that still had a winner)? Most shootout wins first, ties alphabetically.
cypher: MATCH (m:Match)-[r:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE m.home_score = m.away_score AND ((type(r) = 'HOME_TEAM' AND m.result = 'home team win') OR (type(r) = 'AWAY_TEAM' AND m.result = 'away team win')) WITH t, count(m) AS shootout_wins WHERE shootout_wins >= 2 RETURN t.name AS team, shootout_wins ORDER BY shootout_wins DESC, team

question: How many matches did the host nation win at the {year} World Cup, shootouts included?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tournament {year: $year})<-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]-(m:Match)-[r:HOME_TEAM|AWAY_TEAM]->(team:Team) WHERE team.name = t.host_country AND ((type(r) = 'HOME_TEAM' AND m.result = 'home team win') OR (type(r) = 'AWAY_TEAM' AND m.result = 'away team win')) RETURN team.name AS host, count(m) AS wins

question: Who has scored at least ten goals at Women's World Cups, not counting own goals? List by goals, then by name.
cypher: MATCH (g:Goal)-[:SCORED_BY]->(p:Player), (g)-[:SCORED_IN]->(:Match)-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(t:Tournament) WHERE g.own_goal = false AND t.name CONTAINS "Women's" WITH p, count(g) AS goals WHERE goals >= 10 RETURN CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END AS player, goals ORDER BY goals DESC, player

question: Which players were sent off at the {year} World Cup?
cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:SENT_OFF_IN]->(:Match)-[:IN_TOURNAMENT]->(:Tournament {year: $year}) RETURN DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.given_name = 'not applicable' THEN p.family_name ELSE p.given_name + ' ' + p.family_name END AS player
